regime_context: Detector shows a clear AI-infrastructure leadership cluster (SMH proxy shared by the top three themes) with trend-gate eligibility intact and durability above 0.7, but momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation is 'narrowing'/'directional: false' — so this is a focus/attention read, not a return forecast. The gate_helps=true validates only drawdown control; with hit_rate 0.679 but dir_accuracy 0.488 on 84 calls, directional confidence should stay low.
emerging_watch: Watching Memory, HBM & Storage (SMH proxy) as a possible confirmed handoff from AI Infrastructure — the rotation challenger (score 1.873, margin 0.422) with a clean 'trend' hurst and 0.72 durability. I would retire this watch only after observing Memory's rank move clearly ahead of AI Infrastructure on two consecutive detector prints AND a pullback in SMH that holds above the absolute-trend gate.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has the strongest durability_bar (0.83), trend hurst tag, and perfect breadth (1.0) but is the only crowded scorable theme (crowding_z 1.97, crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — so the lean is expressed as avoid rather than underweight, reflecting that fresh capital should not chase this into the concentration flag.
theses.dissent: Crowding flags have no basket-level forward edge in this detector's own backtest; a crowded trend leader can persist far longer than a caution suggests, and avoiding it may cost participation if the trend continues.

falsifier.text: CIBR beats SMH by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days while remaining above its trend gate

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the confirmed leader (headline + rotation.leader) with strong durability_bar (0.71) and high breadth (0.875), and gate_helps=true means the absolute-trend gate genuinely cuts drawdown here — so an overweight lean is defensible as a staying-power expression, not a momentum call. The fading val_state is a caution but not an invalidation given the trend-gate support.
theses.dissent: val_state is 'fading' and hurst is 'mixed', suggesting internal decohesion despite the top rank; the detector's own backtests say rank-IC is ~0, so there is no validated edge in being overweight the leader.

falsifier.text: SMH trails the S&P 500 by more than 5% over the next 40 trading days

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the highest-ranked non-AI/semiconductor eligible theme (rank 7, score 0.883) with a 'trend' hurst tag and eligible=true, but weak breadth (0.545) says leadership is narrow. The lean is a modest diversification-away-from-AI tilt, supported only by the trend gate's drawdown control on this theme's history.
theses.dissent: Breadth near 0.5 means the theme's strength is concentrated in few names; with dir_accuracy at 0.488 there is no validated edge, and energy can mean-revert hard on macro surprises.

falsifier.text: XLE lags XLI by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days
